name: Pipeline Orchestrator GitHub App
summary: The identity the orchestrator and reusable workflows act as - reads issues/labels, dispatches pipelines, and commits generated output back to target repos.
auth: GitHub App JWT exchanged for an installation token (GH_APP_ID + GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY + per-owner installation IDs).

notes.body: Auth is implemented in orchestrator/src/integrations/github.ts (jsonwebtoken); the reusable wiki/dev workflows mint a token via actions/create-github-app-token.

name: LiteLLM Gateway
summary: A model gateway on Cloud Run. Every pipeline component calls a model alias (planning / implementation / classification / documentation), never a provider SDK directly.

notes.body: Swapping the model behind an alias is a one-line edit in litellm/config.yaml - nothing downstream changes.

name: Google Cloud Run
summary: Hosts the Express orchestrator and the LiteLLM gateway; both deploy from a Dockerfile via their deploy workflows.

name: Supabase Postgres
summary: External Postgres (via the connection pooler) that LiteLLM requires for virtual-key auth.

name: SerpAPI
summary: Search provider used by the job-search pipeline to source postings.

name: JSearch
summary: Job-listings API used for sourcing and discovery in the job-search pipeline.

name: Model providers
summary: Anthropic (wiki documentation), Gemini (dev pipelines today), OpenAI (fallback), and Ollama (local classification) - all reached only through the LiteLLM gateway.
auth: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY, held by the gateway.

name: GitHub Actions
summary: Runs the reusable pipelines (dev, e2e, wiki) and the deploy workflows for docs, orchestrator, and gateway.
